project.purpose: Source/test qualified independent cross-provider reference responsibilities. Provider-native APIs, caller IAM, Runtime and OPA remain external mature LEGO. No invented mandatory Distribution control plane.

nodes.label: OptionalProviderEffectSafetyProfile
nodes.authority: Distribution source contract profile only; caller IAM, Runtime, Provider and domain retain natural authority
nodes.responsibility: Offer an optional cross-provider reference profile for exact effect identity, provider observation, explicit authority, policy admission and reconciliation without becoming a mandatory global Distribution executor.
inputs: Opt-in caller Distribution intent, provider-native observation, optional bound approval and dispatch/readback evidence
outputs: Validated reference projection or explicit refusal, bounded policy result, reconciliation standing
behavioralContract: The profile composes source contracts only when its consumer chooses it; it neither submits to Provider nor grants IAM privileges, and source-level tests never establish physical publication.
acceptance: scripts/test-all.sh exercises the source boundary independently of external carrier observation.
README and composition-v1 preserve provider-native tools and do not require an extra global workflow authority.
replacementConditions: Replace/delete the optional profile when no necessary live consumer exists; otherwise preserve exact local contract and direct Provider/API adoption.
formalObligations: No verified dynamic/installed caller or domain acceptance; composition safety depends on downstream provider and authority premises.

nodes.label: OccurrenceAndObservationContentIdentity
nodes.authority: Distribution source contract profile only; caller IAM, Runtime, Provider and domain retain natural authority
nodes.responsibility: Bind each effect occurrence and provider observation to exact RFC 8785 JCS/SHA-256 references so that payload, account, carrier and relevant artifact changes invalidate old evidence.
inputs: Typed Distribution intent; carrier/provider identity; exact effect payload and optional artifact; provider observation
outputs: occurrenceRef, provider_observation_ref, effect_payload_ref and canonical evidence projections
behavioralContract: References derive from the actual projected values using mature rfc8785; a digest mismatch is rejected during downstream admission. Digest equality alone is not provider idempotency or effect equality.
acceptance: scripts/test-admission.py explicitly tests altered content, provider/ref mismatch, and exact identity.
No raw filename or mutable alias can substitute a bound occurrence digest.
replacementConditions: Keep canonical projection and SHA-256 identity compatibility; reuse upstream RFC 8785 instead of custom serializer.
formalObligations: No cryptographic collision/external-provider realization property proved by repo tests; exact consumer readset changes must invalidate reuse.

nodes.label: RuntimeBoundObservationNormalization
nodes.authority: Distribution source contract profile only; caller IAM, Runtime, Provider and domain retain natural authority
nodes.responsibility: Normalize an exact read of caller intent and Runtime-bound provider observation into a bounded policy input while rejecting expired, mismatched or ambient provenance.
inputs: Intent/observation/optional authority JSON satisfying Draft202012 schema, Runtime input root and admitted timestamp
outputs: Normalized deterministic admission object or structured fail-closed denial
behavioralContract: Each declared occurrence/provider/account/adapter/effect is bound across documents, validity windows checked and missing Runtime-bound input root rejected; null authority remains present=false, not implicitly granted.
acceptance: scripts/test-admission.py demonstrates expired and mismatched receipt rejection.
replacementConditions: Preserve typed bound read, fail-closed source path, temporal scope and exact nullable authority semantics.
formalObligations: Actual Runtime execBound mounting, identity/visibility and complete dynamic input membership not established by file-level tests.

nodes.label: ExplicitEffectApprovalTranslation
nodes.authority: Distribution source contract profile only; caller IAM, Runtime, Provider and domain retain natural authority
nodes.responsibility: Translate caller-presented exact effect approval into a bounded EffectAuthority descriptor only after verifying occurrence and time, without granting approval itself.
inputs: Exact intent occurrence, optional approval request, independently bound approved principal/effect and trusted Runtime input root
outputs: Approval request awaiting actual user/authority or typed EffectAuthority / explicit refusal
behavioralContract: An approval request is not a grant. Only matched occurrence, principal and validity fields from a separately supplied approval are translated; ambient approval input, payload swaps and stale approval fail closed.
acceptance: scripts/test-effect-authority-producer.py covers mismatched effect/payload/expiry and forged producer-output controls.
replacementConditions: Prefer external IAM/OAuth/provider-native approval; delete translator if consumer can use existing upstream granted token directly with required bindings.
formalObligations: No installed authenticated human approval or live effect authorization is inferred; caller provenance must be proved independently.

nodes.label: ProviderCapabilityEffectPolicy
nodes.authority: Distribution source contract profile only; caller IAM, Runtime, Provider and domain retain natural authority
nodes.responsibility: Determine a bounded preflight/deny/user-action-required outcome using mature OPA/Rego over the verified normalized capability and effect authority envelope.
inputs: D02 normalized provider capability/requirement observation and D03 optional authority descriptor
outputs: OPA decision action with reason and externalEffectPerformed=false in preflight
behavioralContract: OPA policy may accept read-ready or bounded write preflight only under required provider capability, artifact readiness, explicit effect authority and schema assumptions; no preflight result asserts external effect.
acceptance: scripts/test-admission.py tests read-ready/write-approval-required/write-bound and multiple denials against OPA.
policy/distribution.rego never calls a provider or schedules side effects.
replacementConditions: Replace policy by an equivalent mature native Provider authorization decision if consumer requires no cross-provider composition; preserve policy input/output and conservative failure cases.
formalObligations: OPA sample cases pass only scoped finite input classes; absent complete environment/Provider delivery bridge no end-to-end Formal PASS.

nodes.label: AmbiguousProviderEffectReconciliation
nodes.authority: Distribution source contract profile only; caller IAM, Runtime, Provider and domain retain natural authority
nodes.responsibility: Classify ambiguous provider dispatch/readback and permit retry only under independently qualified provider idempotency or authoritative absence proof.
inputs: Exact occurrence, dispatch standing, provider-native readback and bound retry proof
outputs: OPA reconciliation action and explicit retryPermitted boolean
behavioralContract: UNKNOWN or ambiguous submission is not absence and not retry permission; provider-present means effect confirmed; ambiguity permits retry only with actual idempotency or independently verified authoritative absence.
acceptance: scripts/test-reconciliation.py evaluates eight distinct outcome/retry cases.
policy/reconciliation_test.rego adds native Rego policy counterexamples.
replacementConditions: Prefer Provider's own authoritative idempotency/readback; omit this adapter when equivalent real consumer obligations are fully met upstream.
formalObligations: Provider-native readback and retry proof must be source-bound; UNKNOWN physical effect cannot be upgraded to absence.
